notes: Канонический DS owner BenefitsBlock соответствует публичному модулю arui-private/benefit-block и экспортам BenefitBlockDesktop/Mobile.
HeightCustom является строковым Figma VARIANT, а heightCustom в коде — number. Автоматического преобразования нет.
Для preset=list требуется listItems, для preset=steps — stepsItems. Desktop imagePositionDesktop принимает left/right; mobile imagePositionMobile — top/bottom.
RightAddon и TitleAddon отсутствуют в публичном code API. Точный актуальный источник 26 норм не получен; сохраняется историческая проекция 31 правила.
Требование ImageView.Size=348 отменено; замена другим фиксированным размером не вводится.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Actual public path is singular benefit-block; owner componentId web.benefits-block is preserved.
mappings.platformBehavior: Both fixed exports exist; responsive entry uses 768 boundary.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Shared owner semantic Image domain must be restricted per platform before binding.
mappings.platformBehavior: Desktop branch reads imagePositionDesktop; Top/Bottom are unsupported for this field.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Do not derive mobile position from desktop selection.
mappings.platformBehavior: Mobile branch reads imagePositionMobile; Left/Right are unsupported for this field.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Public code field is optional number. Source internal default false is interpolated as falsepx on D by the shown branch; this is source inference, not a runtime defect proof.
mappings.platformBehavior: Desktop effect only; code accepts field on M but branch does not apply height.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Code branch conditionally wraps with BackgroundPlate; current approved background policy remains source-pending.
mappings.platformBehavior: Field exists for both exports; M CSS has no-background modifier.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Code accepts compact on both exports; historical semantic binding is D-only. Current Compact/contentFit norm is source-pending.
mappings.platformBehavior: Desktop title and image classes use compact; M title stays small but image compact class is code-expressible.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Required string in types, but falsy value is not rendered. Required type presence does not prove visible title.
mappings.platformBehavior: D title medium/small by compact; M title small.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Required ReactNode can still be null/falsy; source uses image &&. No fixed Size=348 requirement and no substitute size introduced.
mappings.platformBehavior: ImagePosition is independent for D/M; native asset metadata cannot be inferred from ReactNode.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Source union requires listItems for list and stepsItems for steps; no general custom preset enum.
No public visibility Boolean exists. Omitting preset invokes text default; empty arrays are not invented to simulate a hidden native preset.
mappings.platformBehavior: Text absence can omit subtitle only if owner declares content absent; equivalence of hidden list/steps needs review.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: List items have title; Steps items have title and optional subtitle. No fabricated steps, counts or noop handlers.
mappings.platformBehavior: Steps renders interactive=false and activeStep=null; no action added.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Source uses core Button directly, not arui-private/ButtonGroup. Caller props spread after defaults; no action synthesized.
mappings.platformBehavior: Source size48 on both platforms; block=true on M. Any owner requirement to override is pending current26 source.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Complete current source API does not expose RightAddon/rightTitleAddon. API absence alone does not bind native right-addon role or accept Predicate coverage.
There is no TitleAddon slot in BenefitBlockProps; title is string, not a custom ReactNode slot.
mappings.platformBehavior: Both exports have no corresponding public field.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Full BackgroundPlateProps requires children at type level; JSX owns rendered children. Type requirement must not be met with invented product payload.
mappings.platformBehavior: Source branch uses props only with withBackground=true.

mappings.sourceReviewStatement: Loading, container action, HeightCustom/overflow and visual baseline remain provisional. Code Button→Spinner does not establish whole-block loading.
mappings.platformBehavior: Source behavior and rendered acceptance are distinct; no live expectations created.
